target_statement: For any Valid certificate whose initial phase is SixPhase, prove the temporal phase-code profile: for every i, sixCode((cert.st i).c) = (sixCode((cert.st 0).c)+i) % 6; consequently, because valid_period_mod6 gives 6 | cert.P, every one of the six phase classes {2,4,8,16,14,10} occurs exactly cert.P/6 times among st 0,...,st(P-1).
